result.one_liner: SEO and marketing data API offering project management, ranking tracking, and keyword research with free trial then paid subscription

evidence.quote: A single API key authenticates every endpoint across both the Data API and the Project API
OAuth is recommended for MCP Server—it opens a browser on first connect, stores the token locally
The 14-day free trial gives you 100K API credits across all six API endpoints, as well as MCP server access
A 14-day free trial is available on Core – no credit card required
GET requests can include parameters in the URL's query string, while POST requests must include the Content-Type: application/json header
MCP Server - SE Ranking API Documentation provides OAuth and API key authentication options

result.notes: SE Ranking provides well-documented REST APIs with both API key and OAuth authentication. Free 14-day trial with no credit card required makes it buildable immediately, but production use requires a paid subscription (Core $129/mo minimum). Official MCP server support available. Verdict is yellow due to paid requirement after trial period.
